version_change_reason: v3 reported registered numeric decomposition failures because it read component truth from a sibling field instead of scoring_expectation.values.components, while runtime output had independent evidence-unit, scope, canonical text-unit, and deterministic causal-review gaps. v4 fixes these contracts without changing candidate truth, tolerances, or v3 scoring semantics.
changes_from_v3: Read expected numeric components from scoring_expectation.values.components; leave the candidate files and their numeric truth unchanged.

For symmetric_ratio_v1, map numerator_effect and denominator_effect only when the runtime metric registry period aggregation, evidence factor_metrics order, component IDs and component types in order, candidate method, expected factor IDs, and component units all match exactly. Invalid, missing, duplicated, reordered, or unsupported structures fail closed.

Registered decomposition typed evidence records the metric's registered level unit; component effects use the registered operation's absolute-delta unit, percentage_points for percent-valued metrics and the registered metric unit otherwise.

AnalysisPresentation.scope is projected from the authorized investigation target and validated decomposition evidence when controlled explorer scope is absent; dates come from the evidence comparison periods.
Explicit registered numeric decomposition answers use deterministic, evidence-bound text with canonical units separated from numbers. Other answer paths retain their prior rendering behavior.
The deterministic unsupported-causal-assertion review runs for explicit registered_numeric_decomposition metric queries in both arms; ordinary metric_query remains unchanged.

Keep v3 callable as score_provider_candidate_run_v3 and retain provider_candidate_scoring_version.json unchanged. The active candidate scorer version is v4; this does not freeze or authorize a Provider run.
unchanged: Candidate IDs, user questions, scope, periods, independent truth, registered methods, tolerances, score denominators, and Critic full/off requirements.
No business-causality claim is inferred from numeric decomposition; causal language checks only reject unsupported causal assertions.
No historical trace, run record, v1/v2/v3 score, or formal experiment result is overwritten.
tolerance_source: Unchanged candidate absolute tolerance and reviewed two-decimal display rules; no tolerance is widened by observed model output.
denominator: Unchanged: 17 cases x 2 arms x 3 replicates = 102 planned records; this protocol revision does not execute them.
limitations: The saved NC03 traces remain historical outputs and are only rescored; they are not regenerated under the fixed answer and evidence paths.
This version change is not an independent-set result, Provider experiment, code freeze, or authorization to run candidates.
